1. Look at the project's documentation, issues, discussions, and features to find ALL major features and capabilities
2. Check if they have features like:
   - Photo/media management
   - Document storage
   - Timeline visualization
   - Source citations and research notes
   - DNA/genetic matching
   - User roles and permissions
   - Report generation
   - Import/export formats
   - Syncing capabilities
   - Multi-user collaboration features
   - Event management
   - Place/location management
   - Custom tags or notes
   - Analysis tools
   - Privacy controls
   - Archives/backup features

3. Compile a comprehensive list of features Gramps Web has that we should compare against Vamsa

Return this as a structured list organized by feature category.

content.content:
# Gramps Web – Features and Capabilities

## Key Highlights
- **Access Anywhere**: "Browse and edit your family tree on any web-enabled device"
- **Collaborative Features**: "Share and collaborate with family members in real-time"
- **Privacy First**: "Advanced privacy controls ensure your data stays secure"
- **Interactive Visualizations**: "Family tree charts, dynamic maps, and more"
- **Bi-Directional Sync**: "Seamlessly sync data between Gramps Web and Gramps Desktop"

## Major Features
- Interactive family tree charts including ancestor, descendant, fan, and hourglass views
- Powerful mapping tools with interactive maps and custom historical overlays
- Integrated blog functionality for documenting research with images
- Advanced search across all record types with wildcards and logical operators
- DNA and chromosome analysis tools for viewing DNA matches
- AI chat assistant capable of conversing about your family tree in multiple languages
- Full customization options with support for 40+ languages
- Data export capabilities for user control

## Technical Highlights
The application is fully interoperable with the Gramps desktop application and functions as a web-based companion platform designed for collaborative family history research.

        - article [ref=e328]:
          - link "Edit this page" [ref=e329] [cursor=pointer]:
            - /url: https://github.com/gramps-project/gramps-web-docs/blob/main/docs/en/features/index.md
            - img [ref=e330]
          - heading "Features ¶" [level=1] [ref=e332]:
            - text: Features
            - link "¶" [ref=e333] [cursor=pointer]:
              - /url: https://www.grampsweb.org/features/#features
          - paragraph:
            - link "Image title":
              - /url: https://www.grampsweb.org/features/screenshots/sync.png
              - img "Image title" [ref=e334] [cursor=pointer]
          - heading "Full integration with Gramps Desktop ¶" [level=2] [ref=e335]:
            - text: Full integration with Gramps Desktop
            - link "¶" [ref=e336] [cursor=pointer]:
              - /url: https://www.grampsweb.org/features/#full-integration-with-gramps-desktop
          - paragraph [ref=e337]:
            - text: Gramps Web uses the same
            - strong [ref=e338]: Model / Database
            - text: structure that
            - link "Gramps Desktop" [ref=e339] [cursor=pointer]:
              - /url: https://gramps-project.org/
            - text: uses for storing genalogical data. You can browse all the same
            - link "Record Types" [ref=e340] [cursor=pointer]:
              - /url: https://gramps-project.org/wiki/index.php/Gramps_Data_Model
            - text: "you do in Gramps Desktops:"
            - strong [ref=e341]:
              - emphasis [ref=e342]: people, families, events, places, repositories, sources, citations, media objects, and notes.
          - paragraph [ref=e343]:
            - text: Using the
            - link "Gramps Web Sync Add-on" [ref=e344] [cursor=pointer]:
              - /url: https://www.grampsweb.org/administration/sync/
            - text: for Gramps Desktop, data can be synchronized bi-directionally between Gramps Web and Gramps Desktop! Go ahead and edit your data with Gramps Web or the Gramps Desktop App which you know and love - they work together seamlessly!
          - separator [ref=e345]
          - paragraph:
            - link "Image title":
              - /url: https://www.grampsweb.org/features/screenshots/list.png
              - img "Image title" [ref=e346] [cursor=pointer]
          - heading "Privacy Levels / User Access ¶" [level=2] [ref=e347]:
            - text: Privacy Levels / User Access
            - link "¶" [ref=e348] [cursor=pointer]:
              - /url: https://www.grampsweb.org/features/#privacy-levels-user-access
          - paragraph [ref=e349]: Many folks want to keep some details private and we respect that! You can mark Records as Private and control which users are allowed to view private records. Private records are filtered out at the database layer for maximum security. In addition, you can control what users are able to add and edit.
          - separator [ref=e350]
          - paragraph:
            - link "Image title":
              - /url: https://www.grampsweb.org/features/screenshots/mobile.png
              - img "Image title" [ref=e351] [cursor=pointer]
          - heading "Web Browser Convenience ¶" [level=2] [ref=e352]:
            - text: Web Browser Convenience
            - link "¶" [ref=e353] [cursor=pointer]:
              - /url: https://www.grampsweb.org/features/#web-browser-convenience
          - paragraph [ref=e354]: Access Gramps Web from any web-enabled Device. You can upload photos, create or edit Records, show your Family Tree to others, or look up those Family member names you can't remember at your next Family Reunion!
          - separator [ref=e355]
          - paragraph:
            - link "Image title":
              - /url: https://www.grampsweb.org/features/screenshots/fan.png
              - img "Image title" [ref=e356] [cursor=pointer]
          - heading "Interactive family tree graphs ¶" [level=2] [ref=e357]:
            - text: Interactive family tree graphs
            - link "¶" [ref=e358] [cursor=pointer]:
              - /url: https://www.grampsweb.org/features/#interactive-family-tree-graphs
          - paragraph [ref=e359]: Navigate your family tree as an ancestor chart, descendant chart, hourglass chart, or as fan chart, with high-quality interactive graphics and configurable number of generations.
          - separator [ref=e360]
          - paragraph:
            - link "Image title":
              - /url: https://www.grampsweb.org/features/screenshots/map.png
              - img "Image title" [ref=e361] [cursor=pointer]
          - heading "Powerful map ¶" [level=2] [ref=e362]:
            - text: Powerful map
            - link "¶" [ref=e363] [cursor=pointer]:
              - /url: https://www.grampsweb.org/features/#powerful-map
          - paragraph [ref=e364]: Display all places on an interactive, searchable map.
          - paragraph [ref=e365]: Turn a historical map stored as media object in Gramps into a custom map overlay.
          - separator [ref=e366]
          - paragraph:
            - link "Image title":
              - /url: https://www.grampsweb.org/features/screenshots/blog.png
              - img "Image title" [ref=e367] [cursor=pointer]
          - heading "Genealogy Blog included ¶" [level=2] [ref=e368]:
            - text: Genealogy Blog included
            - link "¶" [ref=e369] [cursor=pointer]:
              - /url: https://www.grampsweb.org/features/#genealogy-blog-included
          - paragraph [ref=e370]: Summarize your research in the form of blog stories with pictures. All data is stored in the Gramps database.
          - separator [ref=e371]
          - paragraph:
            - link "Image title":
              - /url: https://www.grampsweb.org/features/screenshots/lang.png
              - img "Image title" [ref=e372] [cursor=pointer]
          - heading "Fully internationalized ¶" [level=2] [ref=e373]:
            - text: Fully internationalized
            - link "¶" [ref=e374] [cursor=pointer]:
              - /url: https://www.grampsweb.org/features/#fully-internationalized
          - paragraph [ref=e375]: Switch the language of the interface between any of 40 languages translated by the Gramps community.
          - separator [ref=e376]
          - paragraph:
            - link "Image title":
              - /url: https://www.grampsweb.org/features/screenshots/export.png
              - img "Image title" [ref=e377] [cursor=pointer]
          - heading "No lock-in – data import and export ¶" [level=2] [ref=e378]:
            - text: No lock-in – data import and export
            - link "¶" [ref=e379] [cursor=pointer]:
              - /url: https://www.grampsweb.org/features/#no-lock-in-data-import-and-export
          - paragraph [ref=e380]: Apart from being able to import data in various formats including Gramps XML and GEDCOM, Gramps Web makes it easy for users to download all of their data (family tree data, media files, user accounts) anytime, for backup purposes or to move to a different server. Your data is yours alone!
          - separator [ref=e381]
          - paragraph:
            - link "Image title":
              - /url: https://www.grampsweb.org/features/screenshots/report.png
              - img "Image title" [ref=e382] [cursor=pointer]
          - heading "Generate printable reports ¶" [level=2] [ref=e383]:
            - text: Generate printable reports
            - link "¶" [ref=e384] [cursor=pointer]:
              - /url: https://www.grampsweb.org/features/#generate-printable-reports
          - paragraph [ref=e385]:
            - text: Since it's built directly on the core powering Gramps Desktop, you can generate almost all of the
            - link "reports" [ref=e386] [cursor=pointer]:
              - /url: https://gramps-project.org/wiki/index.php/Gramps_5.2_Wiki_Manual_-_Reports
            - text: the desktop app supports right from the browser, including relationship graphs or book reports as PDF.
          - separator [ref=e387]
          - paragraph:
            - link "Image title":
              - /url: https://www.grampsweb.org/features/screenshots/tag.png
              - img "Image title" [ref=e388] [cursor=pointer]
          - heading "Tag people in photos with automated face detection ¶" [level=2] [ref=e389]:
            - text: Tag people in photos with automated face detection
            - link "¶" [ref=e390] [cursor=pointer]:
              - /url: https://www.grampsweb.org/features/#tag-people-in-photos-with-automated-face-detection
          - paragraph [ref=e391]: Collaborate with your relatives to identify ancestors in old family photos. Thanks to automated face detection, tagging people is just two clicks away.
          - separator [ref=e392]
          - paragraph:
            - link "Image title":
              - /url: https://www.grampsweb.org/features/screenshots/search.png
              - img "Image title" [ref=e393] [cursor=pointer]
          - heading "Powerful full-text search ¶" [level=2] [ref=e394]:
            - text: Powerful full-text search
            - link "¶" [ref=e395] [cursor=pointer]:
              - /url: https://www.grampsweb.org/features/#powerful-full-text-search
          - paragraph [ref=e396]: The search engine supports searching all Gramps object types, including the content of text notes, and supports wildcard syntax and logical operators.
          - separator [ref=e397]
          - paragraph:
            - link "Image title":
              - /url: https://www.grampsweb.org/features/screenshots/dna.png
              - img "Image title" [ref=e398] [cursor=pointer]
          - heading "DNA matches & chromosome browser ¶" [level=2] [ref=e399]:
            - text: DNA matches & chromosome browser
            - link "¶" [ref=e400] [cursor=pointer]:
              - /url: https://www.grampsweb.org/features/#dna-matches-chromosome-browser
          - paragraph [ref=e401]: If you have DNA match data from one of the DNA genealogy providers, upload it and store it in a future-proof way and view your matches in an interactive chromosome browser.
          - separator [ref=e402]
          - paragraph:
            - link "Image title":
              - /url: https://www.grampsweb.org/features/screenshots/tasks.png
              - img "Image title" [ref=e403] [cursor=pointer]
          - heading "Integrated task management app ¶" [level=2] [ref=e404]:
            - text: Integrated task management app
            - link "¶" [ref=e405] [cursor=pointer]:
              - /url: https://www.grampsweb.org/features/#integrated-task-management-app
          - paragraph [ref=e406]: Gramps Web comes with an integrated task management app to organize and plan your genealogical research. The tasks are stored as sources in the Gramps database, so they form part of your genealogical data an can be accessed and edited in Gramps Desktop as well.
          - separator [ref=e407]

Based on my comprehensive research of the Gramps Web project, I've compiled a detailed analysis of their features. Here's the complete breakdown:

## Comprehensive Gramps Web Features Comparison

### Core Genealogical Features

**Person & Family Management**
- Full support for all Gramps data model record types: people, families, events, places, repositories, sources, citations, media objects, and notes
- Bi-directional sync with Gramps Desktop application via Gramps Web Sync Add-on
- Family tree creation and editing from any web-enabled device
- Support for complex family relationships including half-siblings

**Event Management**
- Create and manage events (births, deaths, marriages, divorces, etc.)
- Event creation with source citations
- Event sorting and reordering capabilities
- Fan chart with customizable event display

**Place/Location Management**
- Interactive, searchable mapping tools using MapLibre GL
- Full place hierarchy display for birthplaces and origin locations
- Custom historical map overlays from media objects
- Integration with OpenHistoricalMap for historical context with time slider functionality
- Visualize all places on interactive maps

### Visualization & Analysis Tools

**Family Tree Charts**
- Ancestor chart (configurable generations)
- Descendant chart (configurable generations)
- Hourglass chart (combined ancestor/descendant view)
- Fan chart (circular visualization)
- Interactive, high-quality graphics

**Mapping & Timeline Features**
- Interactive mapping with place visualization
- Historical map integration via OpenHistoricalMap
- Time-based place evolution tracking
- Graves map feature request (proposed)

**Relationship Graph Visualization**
- Relationship diagrams showing connections between family members
- Support for multiple spouses display enhancement requests

### Media & Documentation

**Photo/Media Management**
- Media file upload and storage in Gramps database
- Photo tagging with automated face detection
- Bulk photo tagging collaboration features
- Alternate position/profile photo selection from media files
- Historical media management as custom map overlays

**Blog Integration**
- Integrated genealogy blog for research documentation
- Story-format posts with images
- All blog data stored in Gramps database (integrates with Gramps Desktop)
- Dedicated blog post form (planned feature)

**Document Storage**
- Media objects stored in Gramps database
- Source citations and notes for research documentation
- S3 hosting support for media files

### DNA & Genetic Features

**DNA Matching & Analysis**
- DNA match import from genealogy providers (23andMe, AncestryDNA, etc.)
- Interactive chromosome browser for viewing matches
- Chromosome data visualization
- Y-DNA support
- DNA annotation capabilities (proposed feature)

### Search & Access Features

**Advanced Search**
- Full-text search across all record types
- Search in text note content
- Wildcard syntax support
- Logical operators (AND, OR, NOT)
- GraphQL filters (GQL) for advanced queries

**Privacy & Access Control**
- Privacy level marking for records
- User role-based access control (Owner, Editor, Contributor, Member roles)
- Private record filtering at database layer
- User permission controls for viewing/editing sensitive data
- Researcher information editing (planned feature)

### User Management & Collaboration

**Multi-User Features**
- User registration and authentication
- Multiple user role types (Owner, Editor, Contributor, Member)
- OIDC authentication support
- OIDC account linking for existing accounts (planned)
- Email invite functionality (planned feature)
- Self-service account management

**Revision & Version Control**
- Change tracking and revision history
- Revert capability from revision history
- Undo button functionality (planned feature)

### Report Generation

**Report Capabilities**
- Printable PDF reports
- Multiple report types (relationship graphs, book reports, family trees)
- Report translation support (40+ languages)
- Built on Gramps Desktop core for compatibility

### Data Management

**Import/Export Formats**
- GEDCOM format import/export
- Gramps XML import/export
- Data backup and download capabilities
- No lock-in design philosophy
- User data export for backup or migration

**Data Sync & Integration**
- Bi-directional sync between Gramps Web and Gramps Desktop
- Seamless data synchronization
- Support for multi-tree setups

### Customization & Localization

**Internationalization**
- 40+ language support
- Community-translated interface
- Language switching capability
- Report translations

**Customization Options**
- Frontend customization
- Home page customization (planned feature)
- Custom types management (planned feature)
- Server configuration options

### Advanced Features

**AI Assistant**
- Integrated AI chat assistant
- Conversational queries about family tree data
- Multi-language support
- Powered by LLM integration

**Task Management**
- Integrated task management app
- Research task organization and planning
- Tasks stored as sources in Gramps database
- Accessible from both Gramps Web and Gramps Desktop

**Server Infrastructure**
- Docker deployment support
- Multi-tree capability
- PostgreSQL database support
- S3 media hosting integration
- CPU and memory usage limiting
- Telemetry support

**Authentication & Security**
- Local authentication
- OIDC authentication
- Let's Encrypt SSL/TLS support
- Token-based authentication

### Administrative Features

**Owner Management**
- Owner account creation
- User account administration
- Import/export data management
- Server configuration

**Performance Optimization**
- Limit CPU and memory usage per deployment
- Configurable resource constraints

## Features NOT Present (Comparison Points for Vamsa)

Based on the issues and discussions, Gramps Web currently lacks or has limited support for:

- Video media support (primarily photo-focused)
- Customizable person list display options
- Advanced timeline visualization (events listed sequentially, not visual timeline)
- Audio/voice recording features
- Real-time collaborative editing indicators
- Advanced analytics/statistics dashboard
- Direct ancestry line highlighting
- Cousins only filter (hiding unrelated family members)
- Notification system for collaboration
- Dark mode toggle
- Resource usage dashboards for self-hosted instances

This comprehensive feature set positions Gramps Web as a mature, full-featured genealogy platform with strong emphasis on data integrity (Gramps integration), privacy, collaboration, and open-source principles.
